backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a social media services marketplace with user profiles, services (followers/likes/views for Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), orders, testimonials, and role-based access control (admin/user permissions) using Internet Identity authentication.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: Arabic RTL homepage with IBAZEX branding, admin dashboard with authentication, customer order system, and Internet Identity integration, with high confidence and mapped test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend React/TypeScript components including App routing, hooks for backend queries and cart management, Arabic UI components (Header, Footer, Hero, Services, Cart, Checkout), and admin dashboard with service/order/testimonial management.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining color schemes for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and sidebar components using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configured for Arabic RTL layout with meta tags, favicon, Inter font preload, and root div for React mounting with Arabic page title for SMM services.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup defining routes (home, services, admin), Layout component with Header/Footer/ProfileSetupDialog, ThemeProvider, CartProvider, and authentication-gated admin access using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Authentication gate component that checks if user is logged in and has admin privileges before rendering admin dashboard children, showing login or access denied screens otherwise.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashb: Main admin dashboard component with tabbed interface for overview, services, orders, and testimonials management sections.
frontend/src/components/admin/DashboardO: Dashboard overview displaying key metrics (total orders, pending orders, total revenue) and recent order activity in card layouts.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersTabl: Table component for viewing and managing all customer orders with status update functionality (pending, completed, cancelled).
frontend/src/components/admin/ServiceMan: Service management interface for adding new services, editing prices, and toggling service availability with dialog forms and table display.
frontend/src/components/admin/Testimonia: Component for managing customer testimonials with ability to add new testimonials including customer name, service type, rating, and text.
frontend/src/components/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart sidebar component (content truncated in provided source).
frontend/src/components/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component (content truncated in provided source).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Arabic footer with IBAZEX branding, quick navigation links, social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), contact details (+212615473531), copyright notice, and Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header component with Internet Identity authentication, displaying user profile when logged in, and providing links to home, services, and admin pages with Arabic RTL support.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Landing page hero section with animated logo, tagline, feature cards (followers, likes, views), WhatsApp contact info, and call-to-action buttons for browsing services.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users to enter their name for profile setup, with form validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Card component displaying a social media service with platform/service type icons, pricing calculator, quantity slider, and order dialog that generates WhatsApp messages with order details.
frontend/src/components/ServicesPage.tsx: Services listing page with platform filter tabs (all, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) that displays available services in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Customer testimonials section displaying reviews with ratings, service type badges, and customer names in a responsive card grid layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCart.tsx: Provides a React context and hook for managing shopping cart state, including adding/removing items, updating quantities, calculating totals, and clearing the cart.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication for ICP, providing a React context and hook for login, logout, identity management, and authentication status tracking with AuthClient integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations, including services, orders, testimonials, and user profiles, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, RTL layout for Arabic text, and custom animation utilities (fade-in, slide-in, zoom-in).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Generates pre-filled WhatsApp URLs with Arabic-formatted order details including service type, quantity, price, and customer account information for order placement.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including HSL-based color system, container settings, border radius variables, Inter font family, and accordion animations with typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file for an Arabic RTL social media services marketplace (IBAZEX) tracking features like homepage, admin dashboard, customer order system, and Internet Identity authentication with pending and in-progress feature requests.
